qa.question: Should the turbine type for both units be aeroderivative gas turbine?
qa.finding: The 2024 Kentucky air permit (https://dep.gateway.ky.gov/eSearch.WebApi/api/documentGenerate/getDocument/12647679) names Pratt and Whitney FT8-3 SwiftPac 60 packages. The permit counts four turbines in two pairs, one pair for each tracker unit. The tracker shows gas turbine.
qa.recommendation: Change the technology to aeroderivative gas turbine for both units, and consider setting Number Of Engines to 2 and Capacity Per Engine to about 30 MW.
qa.note: I did not change the technology because the brief did not ask for a technology check. The per-turbine rating is not stated in the permit. Only the pair output of 60.3 MW is.
